name: Snapshot Sampler & State-Lock Hardening
changes: Adds one background SAB Queue/History sampler that publishes fresh pairs before housekeeping; routine Downloads snapshots and the completion monitor consume the same coherent pair instead of independently competing for serialized localhost control traffic, and fresh-sample tombstone/duplicate cleanup is owned by the sampler.

Makes the presentation-only shared-state refresh bounded and non-blocking across both the in-process state lock and cross-process ledger lock; strict mutation/control/import paths keep blocking authoritative locking, while Downloads safely reuse current in-memory state when either lock is busy. Presentation rendering no longer performs statistics reconciliation, SAB cleanup, adoption/import kicking, failure feedback, browser flattening, or strict state saves.

Routes the small amount of durable bookkeeping discovered during presentation through a deferred background state flush, and moves terminal/PAR2 evidence persistence to the completion worker so HTTP rendering never waits on the ledger writer.
Adds explicit snapshot phase telemetry for shared-state refresh and engine-status work plus worst-build timestamp/phase attribution, preserving the v3.6.49 p50/p90/p95/p99 sample window.
Keeps explicit control actions on fresh authoritative Queue/History reads while sampler consumers never drive destructive recovery from a stale sample.

Compacts seven-day-old successful/satisfied Automation target candidate transcripts to the selected/top candidate and removes expired attempted-release memory while preserving blacklists, selection reason, active/waiting/problem targets and the existing 45-day target retention.
Removes the two known retired NewzDeckBootstrap.exe and NewzDeckCore.exe binaries during installer upgrade with targeted InstallDelete entries; no broad program-directory purge is introduced.

Preserves v3.6.49 bounded Downloads data plane, provider-health background caching, Library Integrity caching, Smart Import output ownership, legacy state compaction, v3.6.48 integrity protections, v3.6.47 Selected Episodes/PAR2 visibility and private SABnzbd 5.1.2.
regression_guards: All established automation identity, Library Integrity, scan, quality, Selected Episodes, PAR2/repair and v3.6.49 data-plane regressions remain mandatory.
v3.6.50 guards require routine live Queue/History consumers to read the background sample while explicit non-live control reads retain the authoritative fetch path.

Synthetic held-lock tests require the snapshot refresh path to return within its bounded budget when either the in-process state lock or cross-process ledger is owned. The snapshot function is forbidden from directly calling strict state saves, statistics reconciliation, SAB cleanup, adoption/import, failure feedback or other background mutation helpers.
Automation runtime tests require old imported/satisfied candidate history to compact while waiting/error/active targets and blacklists remain intact.
Installer source must explicitly remove only the retired NewzDeckBootstrap.exe and NewzDeckCore.exe binaries in addition to the existing Python bytecode cache cleanup.
The release workflow runs the new v3.6.50 regression guard before any Windows release artifacts are built.
